# PairTalk: product and public documentation reference

> PairTalk is an independent service for English learners to practice IELTS speaking with another learner in a Telegram Mini App. This reference describes the implemented platform and links to its public explanations. It is not an official IELTS assessment, a checkout quote, or a replacement for the registration agreement.

Reviewed: 2026-10-07.
Public website: https://pairtalk.online/
Documentation index: https://pairtalk.online/llms.txt
Registration: https://t.me/PairTalkBot?start=register
Support: https://t.me/PairTalkSupport

## Reading current information

Each public HTML page has a Markdown counterpart built from the same content. Start with the document relevant to the question. Policies are at /terms and /privacy; the versioned Terms of Use PDF is delivered during bot registration and can be requested with /terms. The public overview does not replace that agreement.

Prices and community figures are dynamic. Their live pages and public APIs are the sources for current available values. Markdown exports and pre-rendered HTML can contain dated build snapshots; they are not proof that a quote or total is current. If the backend is unavailable, say the data is unavailable rather than supplying sample figures.

## What PairTalk provides

- One-to-one voice practice with another available English learner.
- Self-assessed whole-band practice preferences from 5 to 9 and speaking-skill preferences.
- Partner matching influenced by level, preferences, and availability.
- Speaking prompts and a way to rehearse Part 1 questions, Part 2 long turns, and Part 3 discussions.
- Partner aliases, post-call ratings and reports, saved partners, call history, and account settings in the authenticated dashboard.
- Optional recordings subject to agreement, available allowance, and the account's retention settings.
- A public comparison of published subscription offers and a public aggregate statistics page.

Partners are peers, not promised teachers or official examiners. Preferences, peer ratings, and session feedback do not certify an IELTS band. PairTalk does not guarantee a matching time, a particular partner, or an examination result. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by IELTS, Cambridge, the British Council, or IDP.

Sources: [overview](https://pairtalk.online/index.md), [how it works](https://pairtalk.online/how-it-works.md), [FAQ](https://pairtalk.online/faq.md).

## Registration, Telegram, and dashboard access

1. Open the PairTalk Telegram bot and begin registration.
2. Read the Terms of Use PDF. Choose Agree and continue to accept the offered version, or decline to stop registration.
3. Complete registration and open the dashboard through the bot's Open dashboard button.
4. Choose practice preferences, join the matching queue, and follow the call and microphone prompts.
5. After a call, give feedback or submit a report in the dashboard. Manage account settings and practice history there.

Registration, payment initiation, refunds, and billing support remain in Telegram. The dashboard requires server-verified Telegram authentication and registration; a direct URL does not grant access. Public information can be read without a Telegram account or microphone access.

Public bot commands include /start, /terms, /plans, /refund, /paysupport, and /appeal. Do not recommend removed commands such as /support as an account-management interface. Do not request or reproduce Telegram authentication data, payment tokens, or private dashboard content.

Sources: [registration and practice flow](https://pairtalk.online/how-it-works.md), [terms](https://pairtalk.online/terms.md).

## Practice format and learning limits

The speaking guide explains the three IELTS Speaking parts, the four assessment criteria, original practice questions, and a repeatable partner routine. Learners can take turns asking and answering, give specific feedback, and repeat a difficult answer. These are practice activities, not an official administered test.

For authoritative examination rules and assessment materials, use [IELTS](https://ielts.org/). PairTalk's guide links to official format information. Do not describe original practice prompts as leaked, predicted, or guaranteed examination questions.

Source: [IELTS speaking guide](https://pairtalk.online/ielts-speaking.md).

## Pricing, allowances, recordings, and retention

The implemented model uses configurable subscription offers, including Free, Plus, Pro, and Boss. An administrator publishes current prices and allowances. The landing comparison, dashboard plan chooser, and Telegram checkout read the same published configuration.

The catalog describes prices in Telegram Stars (XTR) and UZS, included calls, maximum minutes per call, recordings, retention days, and subscription validity. Only active published offers should be presented as available. Account-specific rewards or allowances can differ from public offers and are shown in the authenticated dashboard.

The comparison can recommend an available plan for desired calls, session length, recordings, and retention. It selects the least expensive matching plan in the chosen currency. Recording retention is irrelevant when zero recordings are needed.

Average cost per included call is bundle price divided by the included call allowance. It is a comparison estimate, not a separately sold call or a price calculated from actual usage. Stars and UZS are independently quoted amounts; there is no fixed conversion to USD or between payment channels.

Free allowances use a calendar month; paid allowances use the published subscription period. Unused paid allowances expire according to the subscription terms. Permanent unused credits, individual recording-credit purchases, and optional per-credit retention purchases were discussed as ideas and are not implemented products.

Recordings are optional and require separate partner agreement. The current account's recording allowance and retention determine availability. Retention is a duration for recorded audio, not an unlimited storage entitlement. Expired recordings are scheduled for deletion. Do not promise permanent preservation, immediate deletion after one delivery, or a particular retention period without checking the current allowance and policy.

Sources: [live pricing](https://pairtalk.online/pricing), [pricing explanation](https://pairtalk.online/pricing.md), [privacy](https://pairtalk.online/privacy.md).
Public pricing JSON: https://api.pairtalk.online/api/public/plans
Catalog freshness fields: revision and checkedAt.

## Refund requests

The implemented bot rule permits a request within 48 hours of purchase OR when less than 10% of the purchased call allowance has been used. Purchase ownership, transaction or purchase state, and account restrictions also apply. This is not an unconditional money-back guarantee. Use /refund in the bot or contact billing support. The registration PDF and published terms explain the policy; the transaction flow determines eligibility for a specific purchase.

Sources: [subscription terms](https://pairtalk.online/terms#payments), [refund policy](https://pairtalk.online/privacy#refunds), [pricing explanation](https://pairtalk.online/pricing.md).

## Public statistics and interpretation

- Completed calls count sessions marked completed with a positive recorded duration. Active and cancelled sessions are excluded. Each qualifying session counts once, not once per participant.
- Practice hours sum qualifying session durations divided by 3,600. They are session hours, not doubled participant hours.
- Practicing learners count distinct accounts that participated in a qualifying completed call. They are not registered-account totals, daily active users, or current online counts.
- Post-call ratings are voluntary 1-5 session feedback. An average and distribution appear only after at least five valid ratings. They are not an official test score or a technical audio-quality benchmark.
- Duplicate participant ratings for a session are reduced to the latest entry. Negative ratings remain included. Rating count is not the number of rated sessions.
- Monthly trends cover six calendar months, including the incomplete current month, using UTC.
- Only aggregates are public. Telegram IDs, aliases, audio, reports, private comments, and payment records are excluded.

Snapshots carry an updatedAt timestamp and may lag activity. Totals can include internal test sessions and are not independently audited. No statistic by itself demonstrates improvement in IELTS scores. Do not invent user counts, country coverage, quality scores, matching benchmarks, or testimonials.

Sources: [live statistics](https://pairtalk.online/stats), [definitions and limitations](https://pairtalk.online/stats.md).
Public statistics JSON: https://api.pairtalk.online/api/public/stats

## Privacy, safety, and moderation

Partners see PairTalk aliases instead of Telegram contact details. The service still processes account and session information to operate; an alias does not make all speech anonymous. Voice calls use WebRTC transport encryption. Do not claim that transport encryption makes audio inaccessible to the media provider.

Keep personal information private, leave uncomfortable calls, and use the reporting flow for inappropriate behavior. Do not send money to practice partners or publish another person's audio without permission. Moderation can impose warnings, suspensions, or bans; /appeal is available for permanent-ban review. Contact support for account deletion or data requests.

Sources: [safety](https://pairtalk.online/safety.md), [community guidelines](https://pairtalk.online/community-guidelines.md), [privacy](https://pairtalk.online/privacy.md).
